primary_witness.selection: eta=2^-(1+(71 mod 4)); first power of two m with ((1+eta)/(1+eta/2))^m > 26

power_oracle.coverage: full magnitude period of both positive and negative dense matrix powers, 0 through lcm(cycle lengths)-1

resolvent_oracle.coverage: each full dense inverse compared entrywise with independent affine solves on every basis vector; below/at/above eta=delta checked against the stated regime bounds

near_unit_family.coverage: exact least m with q^m>26, including failed m-1 inequality; no dense inverse at these large lengths

polynomial_guard.coverage: all ordered root tuples in the stated degree range, both eta values; exact dense inverse norm tested only when the sufficient guard admits

sharp_local_cap.coverage: exact attaining witness checked by direct multiplication of every cyclic contiguous path, and against the prefix certificate

sharp_inverse.coverage: dense inverses of all 96 attaining cycles; additional 256-cycle exact affine solves for eta=1/16 at each of the three gap regimes

complex_phase_inverse.coverage: 108 dense Gaussian-rational inverses; exact squared row norms checked against the sharp magnitude-interval bound and the separate cycle-phase denominator

stopping_rule: Complete these finite domains and the named negative controls; no adaptive random search and no claim that finite checks prove the all-length statements.
